# LLM eval

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Run a promptfoo (or custom) LLM eval suite and gate on pass rate and cost

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/llm-eval@v1
```

## How it works

Run an LLM evaluation suite and gate the pipeline on the result.

Prompts are code, and like code they regress — a wording change that improves one case
quietly breaks four others. This action runs an eval suite on every PR and turns it into
a pass/fail check with a diffable score, so prompt changes get the same treatment as any
other change.

  runner: promptfoo (default) → runs `promptfoo eval`, reads its JSON output.
  runner: custom              → runs your own command; you supply a results JSON in the
                                same shape (see `results-file`). Use this for DeepEval,
                                Braintrust, Inspect, or a bespoke pytest harness.

Gating is on `threshold` (minimum pass rate). `baseline-file` additionally fails the run
on a *regression* relative to a stored score, which catches the case where the suite was
already below threshold and got worse.

Cost control matters here — an eval suite is N model calls per run. `max-cost-usd` aborts
the step if the suite spends more than you budgeted.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runner` | no | `promptfoo` | promptfoo \| custom |
| `config` | no | `promptfooconfig.yaml` | promptfoo config file. |
| `command` | no | `""` | Command to run for `runner: custom`. Must write `results-file`. |
| `results-file` | no | `eval-results.json` | Path to the JSON results. promptfoo writes it; a custom runner must produce `{ "results": { "stats": { "successes": N, "failures": N }, ... } }` or set `pass-rate-jq` to point at your own shape. |
| `pass-rate-jq` | no | `[(.results.stats.successes // 0), (.results.stats.failures // 0)]` | jq expression evaluated against `results-file` returning `[passes, failures]`. Override this to consume a non-promptfoo results shape. |
| `threshold` | no | `100` | Minimum pass rate to succeed, as a percentage (0-100). |
| `baseline-file` | no | `""` | JSON file holding a previous score (`{"pass_rate": 92.5}`). When present, the run also fails if the pass rate dropped by more than `max-regression`. |
| `max-regression` | no | `0` | Allowed drop in percentage points versus the baseline. |
| `max-cost-usd` | no | `""` | Fail if the suite costs more than this. Empty disables the check. |
| `promptfoo-version` | no | `latest` | promptfoo version to install. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | true to let promptfoo reuse cached responses for unchanged cases. |
| `concurrency` | no | `4` | Parallel eval requests. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory to run in. |
| `env-vars` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` pairs exported before the run — this is how provider API keys reach the eval (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY=...`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...`). |
| `fail-on-threshold` | no | `true` | false to report the score without failing the step. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `pass-rate` | Pass rate as a percentage with one decimal place. |
| `passes` | Number of passing cases. |
| `failures` | Number of failing cases. |
| `total` | Total cases evaluated. |
| `cost-usd` | Total cost reported by the runner, when available. |
| `passed` | `true` when the suite met the threshold and regression budget. |
| `comment-body-file` | Markdown summary file, ready for the `pr-comment` action. |
| `results-file` | Path to the raw results JSON. |
